Natural: Windows Server 2012 R2 Standard Download Medium sized organizations can take opportunities in their daily virtualization needs using the features of Windows Server 2012 Standard. It offers security and access to shared information, print services, and file sharing. Windows Server 2012 Standard includes physical servers that require permission for every unit. Every license covers two processors so if a business operates four CPUs, it will require two licenses and so on. Every license involves two Windows Server virtual machines from that particular physical server. CAL or Client Access License is needed for each device or user to gain access to the server. Windows Server 2012 Standard approves two licenses for Windows Server virtual machines. This is different from Windows Server 2012 Datacenter that sets no limitations on the users numbers.
